skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the economic aspects of pollution, measure economic damages caused by pollution, and evaluate the economic value of resources and environment.

Understand and explain new approaches and trends in addressing environmental issues during economic and social development such as green growth, circular economy, low-carbon economy, and climate change economy.
Apply economic and management tools to propose and implement solutions for sustainable development in the field of environmental and resource management.
Evaluate, analyze, and make decisions aligned with sustainable development goals, environmental protection, and natural capital preservation.
Demonstrate self-study and research skills to complete assignments and solve practical problems.
Show awareness of class rules, cooperation, and personal responsibility in assigned activities.
Prepare and deliver group presentations on river basin management topics.
Engage in discussions, answer questions, and participate in class activities.
